top_signals.title: Allspring’s Miletti Sees Jackson Hole as Bigger Risk Than Nvidia
top_signals.summary: Allspring Global Investments’ Ann Miletti said Wall Street has more to worry about from next week’s Jackson Hole economic symposium than earnings from AI bellwether Nvidia Corp.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Mexican Governor Accused by US of Cartel Ties Returns to His Job
top_signals.summary: The Mexican governor accused by the US of conspiring with a major criminal cartel to traffic drugs is ending his leave of absence, pledging to finish out his term through next year in a move that could inflame tensions with Washington.
